pricing_power: Fixed-price defense charges (VC-25B booked a 280M USD loss in Q2, 2026-07-28); a SPEEA strike after the 2026-10-06 contract expiry would halt 777 certification and cut 737 rates (Ortberg 2026-09-16); supplier and engine cost inflation; cert delays extending deferred production.
